messages:
Maya: Quick sync / needed: refreshed battlecard + SDR one-pager + 2-slide webinar narrative + short benchmark blurb by Friday EOD.
Jason: Proposed angle vs cloud vendors: predictable economics + graceful fallbacks, not just raw speed.
Li: Tech hook vs LLM APIs: routing + quantization that tame tail latency. Suggest phrase: 'stable P99s under bursty traffic'.
Sophie: For SDRs avoid hard numbers. Use 'industry-grade latency SLAs' and link to benchmark appendix for engineers.
Carl: Vs infra vendors emphasize ops reduction: 'we handle kernel selection, autoscaling, and cache optimizations so engs ship features.'
Maya: Three narrative pillars: Economics, Reliability, Dev velocity  each get 1-liner + one proof point.
Jason: Economics: "From variable token bills to predictable engineering-friendly capacity." :money_with_wings: 
Li: Reliability: "Automated fallbacks and region-aware routing keep customer flows alive during incidents." :satellite: 
Sophie: Dev velocity: "One API across hosted, dedicated, and private  test once, deploy everywhere." :rocket: 
Maya: Webinar plan: slide1 problem + customer cost vignette; slide2 solution + 5-min demo showing canary rollback to a quantized model.
Carl: Ill record a 10-min demo Wed. Need infra booking.
Jason: SDR one-pager draft bullets: 1) What we do (1 line); 2) Why it matters; 3) Proof points; 4) CTA: benchmark link + webinar sign-up.
Sophie: Add 2 objection handlers: "Why not vendor X?" -> predictable SLOs & fallbacks. "Can we run on-prem?" -> yes, Private deployment + managed control plane.
Li: Will add mini reproducibility snippet for appendix (engineer-facing).
Maya: ops-bot please set reminder for deck review Thu 10:00.
ops-bot: Reminder set for #marketing: 'Battlecard + webinar deck review' Thu 10:00.
Maya: Next steps: Carl (demo by Wed), Li (appendix Wed EOD), Sophie (SDR copy Thu AM), Jason (routing playbook Thu midday). I'll assemble slides and circulate.
